map.身故与满期给付组合 使用指南: Death and Maturity Benefit Combo - User Guide
map.输入死亡给付、满期生存给付、利率与保险期限，分别求定期寿险与满期给付的现值并相加: Enter death benefit, maturity survival benefit, interest rate and insurance term; find present values of term life and maturity benefit separately and add them to get the net premium of endowment insurance, for pricing combined life products.
map.两全保费 = 身故现值 + 满期现值: Endowment premium = present value of death benefit + present value of maturity benefit
map.两全保险 = 定期寿险 + 满期生存给付的现值。: Endowment insurance = term life insurance + present value of maturity survival benefit.
map.身故保障 + 期满返还组合，分别折现后相加得年保费。: Death protection + maturity refund combo; discount each then add to get annual premium.
map.对比纯保障与两全的保费差距。: Compare premium gap between pure protection and endowment.
map.：身故现值 = 100万×A₁ₙ(3%,20) ≈ 100万×0.1488 =: : Death present value = 1 million x A_1n(3%,20) ≈ 1 million x 0.1488 = 148800; maturity present value = 1 million x v^20 = 1 million x 0.5537 = 553700; endowment present value ≈ 702500, spread to annual premium about 47000/year.
map.由索赔频率与平均赔付额求期望损失: Find expected loss from claim frequency and average payout
map.营运费用与保费之比: Ratio of operating expense to premium
map.由一年生存概率求死亡力: Find force of mortality from one-year survival probability
map.两全为什么比定期贵？: Why is endowment more expensive than term insurance?
map.满期一定返还(确定现金流)拉高现值，身故保障再加一层，故保费高于纯身故定期险。: Certain maturity refund (deterministic cash flow) raises present value; death protection adds another layer, so premium exceeds pure term life.
map.两全到期返还算不算白赚？: Does the endowment maturity refund count as free money?
map.不是。满期金是投保人自己的储蓄返还，保费中生存给付部分按预定利率积存，只是把定期: No. The maturity benefit is the policyholder's own savings returned; the survival-benefit portion accumulates at the predetermined rate; it merely bundles term insurance with a savings plan, and total cost is not below the sum of the two.
